# The Flat Set (formerly MODULIV)
> Whole-Home Flat-Pack Living System delivered in 6 flat boxes. 100% tool-free assembly in 60 minutes. Direct-to-consumer DDP doorstep delivery.

The Flat Set is a global direct-to-consumer (DTC) whole-home flat-pack living brand. We re-engineer full-apartment furniture (living, bedroom, and entryway) into standardized compact flat parcels that fit through standard passenger elevators and narrow 70 cm staircases, assembling completely tool-free with heavy-duty mechanical snap brackets.

## Architectural & Design Philosophy
The Flat Set crafts adaptable modern furniture designed for contemporary urban living spaces. Rather than restricting homes to a single fixed aesthetic, our modular system is engineered to effortlessly harmonize across curated modern styles — from Warm Japandi and Scandinavian minimalism to modern mid-century and architectural contemporary interiors, with new curated aesthetic lines released iteratively.

## Core Engineering & Material Specifications
1. 100% FSC-Certified Solid Hardwood:
   - Sourced exclusively from responsibly managed regenerative forests: FSC-certified American White Oak (*Quercus alba*) and FSC-certified North American Black Walnut (*Juglans nigra*).
   - CNC-machined to ±0.1 mm tolerances and finished with zero-formaldehyde, ultra-matte water-based protective lacquer (VOC < 5 g/L).
2. HR45 High-Resilience Fresh-Pressed Foam:
   - High-density HR45 (45 kg/m³) memory-grade polyurethane foam with superior resilience (>60% ball rebound).
   - Fresh-pressed guarantee: foam cushions are precision-compressed and vacuum-sealed within 48 hours of dispatch, preventing foam fatigue, cell degradation, and permanent creasing common in warehouse-stored foam. CertiPUR-US certified.
3. 4 Signature Fabrics (OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class 1 Certified):
   - Caramel Corduroy: 380 g/m², vintage 8-wale ribbed velvet texture, hydrophobic stain-resistant coating.
   - French Bouclé: 480 g/m², heavyweight textured multi-ply loop yarn, Martindale abrasion rating > 45,000 rubs, cozy tactile warmth.
   - Olive Chenille: 420 g/m², plush velvet-soft pile with high yarn density, water-repellent performance nano-treatment, rich earthy moss tone.
   - Scratch-Resistant Tech Fabric: 400 g/m², ultra-dense micro-weave impervious to cat and dog claws (zero catch loops), liquid-beading barrier, Martindale rating > 80,000 rubs.
   - All fabrics meet OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class 1 (safe for infants and pets). All covers feature concealed YKK zippers and are fully removable and machine washable.
4. Heavy-Duty Tool-Free Mechanical Joinery:
   - Pre-mounted 304 stainless steel Snap-Lock brackets and powder-coated dual tension-wedge rail locks.
   - 0 screws, 0 bolts, 0 Allen keys, 0 loose hardware bags. Rated for >1,000 assembly and disassembly cycles.

## Core Product Catalog & Exact Pricing
- Move-In 1-Bedroom Whole-Home Kit ($1,598 USD):
  - 6 flat boxes containing ModuSofa 3-Seater, SnapBed Queen frame, FlatCoffee Table, SnapSide Table, and EntryRack.
  - Complete living + bedroom move-in solution. Coordinated 60-minute solo build. $1,598 bundle pricing offers substantial savings over individual pieces.
- The ModuSofa 3-Seater ($699 USD):
  - 2 flat boxes, 210 cm W × 90 cm D × 78 cm H (Seat height: 42 cm, Seat depth: 62 cm).
  - 15-minute 3-step tool-free mechanical snap-lock assembly, FSC-certified solid American White Oak or Black Walnut base, HR45 fresh-pressed foam, removable OEKO-TEX covers.
- The SnapBed Queen ($899 USD):
  - 2 flat boxes, Queen (160 × 205 × 100 cm) / King sizes.
  - 20-minute 4-step dual tension-wedge rail lock assembly, 100% FSC-certified solid oak/walnut timber slat frame, 500 kg weight capacity, integrated floating headboard.
- Curated Swatch Box ($0 Free + $5 Expedited Airmail):
  - Includes 4 signature fabric swatches, 2 foam density cuts, solid FSC oak and walnut wood chips.
  - Includes an exclusive $50 gift voucher code inside the box lid, valid for 60 days on any furniture purchase.

## Summary of Step-by-Step Assembly Guides
- ModuSofa 3-Seater (15 Minutes, 3 Steps):
  1. Step 1 (Base Unfold & Interlock): Unbox Box 1; unfold dual FSC solid timber base frames; engage male/female 304 stainless snap brackets until an audible 'click' locks base into rigid alignment; attach hand-threaded glider feet.
  2. Step 2 (Backrest & Armrest Drop-Lock): Align twin backrest frames and side armrest units into vertical guide tracks; press down firmly until wedge locks seat securely.
  3. Step 3 (Foam Expansion & Cover Dressing): Unbox Box 2; remove vacuum packaging from HR45 foam cores (recovers 90% fullness immediately); dress with zippered OEKO-TEX fabric covers and secure onto base with integrated anti-slip velcro.
- SnapBed Queen (20 Minutes, 4 Steps):
  1. Step 1 (Staging): Place solid timber headboard and footboard upright in bedroom on protective packaging.
  2. Step 2 (Dual Tension-Wedge Rail Lock): Slide side rails into headboard and footboard corner pockets; depress tension levers to clamp frame rigidly with zero bolts or screws.
  3. Step 3 (Center Spine Installation): Drop the steel-reinforced center spine beam into slotted receiving brackets; adjust leveling feet.
  4. Step 4 (Roll-Out Slat Array): Unroll pre-spaced webbed FSC solid timber slats into side rail ledges; secure end slats into locator dowels (500 kg load capacity).
- 1-Bedroom Whole-Home Kit (60 Minutes, Coordinated 6-Box Build):
  - Box 1 & 2 (Living Room ModuSofa: 15 min), Box 3 & 4 (Bedroom SnapBed Queen: 20 min), Box 5 (FlatCoffee & SnapSide Tables: 15 min), Box 6 (EntryRack & styling: 10 min).

## Competitive Differentiation Summary (vs IKEA, Article, Burrow, Floyd)
- vs IKEA: 100% solid FSC-certified American White Oak / Walnut and HR45 foam vs particleboard/paper veneer and low-density foam; 100% tool-free snap assembly in 15-60 min vs 40+ screws/cams and 3+ hours; DDP doorstep parcel delivery included vs extra freight appointments or U-Haul truck rentals.
- vs Article: Standard parcel elevator fit (<20 cm thick, <24 kg per box, fits 100% passenger elevators) vs bulky rigid crates requiring 2-person white-glove maneuvering; fresh-pressed on-demand foam vs warehouse storage fatigue; $699 sofa vs $1,299+ pricing.
- vs Burrow: Real FSC hardwood frames vs plywood; $699 sofa / $1,598 bundle vs $1,395+ / $3,000+; on-demand choice of 4 signature OEKO-TEX fabrics vs 2-3 domestic stock colors.
- vs Floyd: Pre-mounted tool-free mechanical snap joints vs strap tensioners and thumbscrews; comprehensive coordinated 6-box 1-bedroom system at $1,598 vs disjointed $3,000+ separates; zero-waste local charity donation protocol vs landfill returns.

## Customer FAQs (Authoritative Ground Truth)
- Q: What are the exact product prices?
  A: The ModuSofa 3-Seater is $699 USD; The SnapBed Queen is $899 USD; The Move-In 1-Bedroom Whole-Home Kit is $1,598 USD. Curated Swatch Box is $0 Free with $5 expedited airmail shipping (includes a $50 coupon inside).
- Q: What are regional DDP delivery transit times?
  A: United States & Canada: 14–18 business days (FedEx / UPS Ground); United Kingdom & European Union: 14–18 business days (DPD / DHL Express); Japan & South Korea: 7–10 business days (Sagawa / CJ Logistics); Middle East (UAE & Saudi Arabia): 12–16 business days (Aramex DDP); Australia & New Zealand: 14–20 business days (Australia Post / Toll). All customs clearance, import duties, tariffs, and local VAT/GST are 100% included in the checkout price.
- Q: How does the 100-night trial and donation-over-return policy work?
  A: Customers enjoy a 100-night risk-free in-home trial. If the furniture is not a perfect fit, The Flat Set arranges free pickup by a vetted local charity partner (e.g., Habitat for Humanity, British Heart Foundation). A 100% full refund is issued upon receipt of the donation slip, ensuring zero ocean return transit and zero landfill waste.
- Q: What warranty is provided?
  A: Solid wood frames, internal timber structural members, and stainless steel snap-lock joinery carry a 5-year structural warranty. Cushions, foam core resilience, fabric upholstery, and zippers carry a 2-year manufacturing warranty.
